ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all of the B3-3 Community Shopping District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 7-G in the area bounded by:

the public alley next south of and parallel to West Lill Avenue; then a line 575.5 feet west
of and parallel to North Halsted street; then a line 358.5 feet southeast of the intersection
of West Lill Avenue and Lincoln Avenue as measured along the east right-of-way line of
North Lincoln Avenue; North Lincoln Avenue; a line 313.5 feet southeast of the
intersection of West Lill Avenue and North Lincoln Avenue as measured along the east
right-of-way line of North Lincoln Avenue; and a line 615.5 feet west of and parallel to
North Halsted Street.

to those of a C1-3 Neighborhood Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Common Address of Property: 2505 N LINCOLN AVE., CHICAGO, IL 60614
